rv.q: As a performance work in a tiny storefront, it is an incredibly smart and sophisticated work.
Do not be deterred from experiencing this brave work.

Reader Recommends: THEATER & DANCE Reader reviews of Chicago theater, dance, comedy, and performance arts. Three friends face religious trauma in Church Hurt Red Theater presents the world premiere of Brynne Frauenhoffer’s smart and compassionate drama.

cn.t: Critics praise this philosophically dense world premiere as a complex, word-heavy meditation on repetition and pattern, though its abstract theorizing and impressionistic style may challenge audiences.
